lectures.title: Time and Space Complexity of Stack using Array

cues.en: All right.
In this lecture we are going to look at time and space complexities of methods that we have implemented
in stack using array.
Now the first method is push method.
Push method takes the time complexity of o one and space complexity of O one, because in this case
we are just inserting the element at the end of the array.
So in modern JavaScript engines, inserting an element at the end of the array takes O one time complexity,
and the space complexity is obviously O one.
Now pop method also takes O one time complexity, because here again we are removing the element from
the end of the array and it takes all one time complexity.
Now the space complexity also is o one.
Now then we have peek method.
So in case of peek method we are just returning the top element from the stack.
And this is done by using the index.
So we know that by using index to access any elements of the array is going to take O one time complexity.
That's why the peek method in case of stack takes O one time complexity.
Then we have over here is empty method.
Now is empty method checking that if the stack is empty it's going to return true, otherwise it's returning
false.
So in this case the time complexity is going to be constant time operation.
Now the space complexity also is going to be O one because an additional memory is not used over here.
Now the next method is size method.
So in case of the stack using array we are just returning the length of the array.
And this will take all one time complexity.
And here also space complexity is O one.
Now when it comes to the clear method we are just setting the array to empty array.
And this will take O one time complexity.
And the space complexity is also O one because no additional space used over here.
Now, some of you might think that this operation will allow the nodes to be garbage collected, which
eventually releases space proportional to the number of the elements that were in stack.
But when it comes to the space complexity, the complexity of freeing the memory is not typically accounted
in the space complexity analysis.
That's why the space complexity is O one.
Now, when it comes to the clear method, the time complexity is going to be o one, because we are
just setting the array to an empty array.
And the space complexity is also O one.
Overall, the array packed implementation of stack is efficient for most use cases, it has advantage
of constant time access to the end of the array, which is leveraged in the most stack operations like
push, pop, and peek.
So hopefully everything is clear about stack using array implementation.
Now in the next lecture, we are going to continue to implement the stack using Linked List.
So see you in the next lecture.
